# Component reference / مرجع المكونات

Bokrah v0.9.0 · 49 components · all ten documentation requirements.

[Documentation requirements](documentation-requirements.md) · [Live reference](https://mahfoud-sa.github.io/bokrah-design-system/#documentation)

Every entry includes name/description, usage, variants/sizes, API, states/interactions, accessibility, responsiveness, RTL/localization, code and do/don’t guidance. Signatures are generated from the actual Flutter source; web function types are checked against the package declaration. Unsupported states/variants are stated explicitly.

كل مكون موثق وفق المتطلبات العشرة. تُستخرج التواقيع من مصدر فلاتر الفعلي ويُتحقق من أنواع دوال الويب. تُذكر الخصائص غير المدعومة بوضوح.

## Setup

### Web

```javascript
import '@bokrah/design-system/styles.css';
import {setBokrahLanguage, setBokrahTheme} from '@bokrah/design-system';
setBokrahLanguage('ar');
setBokrahTheme('light');
```

```html
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl" data-bk-theme="light"><body class="bk-root">…</body></html>
```

Import any named binding used by an example from the same package. CSS imports load the shared tokens/fonts; the root class opts the application into component styles. Plain HTML examples require application event handlers unless a binding is explicitly shown. Use unique IDs when combining snippets.

### Flutter

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:bokrah_design_system/bokrah_design_system.dart';

MaterialApp(
  theme: BkTheme.light(arabic: true),
  darkTheme: BkTheme.dark(arabic: true),
  highContrastTheme: BkTheme.highContrast(arabic: true),
  home: const Directionality(
    textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
    child: BkPageScaffold(body: Text('بكرة')),
  ),
);
```

The application configures its actual locale, supportedLocales and Material localization delegates, formats dates/numbers/currency and owns routes/controllers/async state. BkThemeTokens.of(context) exposes the current semantic palette; tokens and foundational utilities are documented in [Foundations](foundations.md). Snippet expressions are compiled by Flutter analysis through the generated example file; that does not prove screen-reader or visual correctness for every consumer layout.

يضبط التطبيق اللغة والترجمات وتنسيق التواريخ والأرقام والعملات ويدير المسارات والحالة. تُحلل أمثلة فلاتر برمجياً؛ لا يغني ذلك عن التحقق المرئي واختبار قارئ الشاشة لكل تخطيط.
